method: Heuristic review (Nielsen's 10 plus 5 airport heuristics, 12 pages, severity 0-4) and scripted simulated walkthroughs of 18 persona tasks (P1-P9, top two tasks each) in Playwright Chromium at 390x844 (touch, mobile) and 1280x800, against the production build served with next start -p 3103 on 2026-11-18 about 17:45-18:30 MYT. Not a study with real users: counts are an expert floor, 'unaided' is evaluator judgement, times are keystroke-level models.

tasks.task: Status, terminal and gate of MH 570 today (strategy task 1)
Price for 3 days parking at KLIA T1, then booking hand-off (task 5)
tasks.outcome: success (upper bound 'At most RM 96' at 3 interactions; hand-off at 4)

tasks.task: Official way from KLIA to KL Sentral with a dated fare (task 4)
tasks.outcome: success (KLIA Ekspres RM 55 until 31 Dec 2026); no anti-touting guidance

tasks.task: What to submit before landing: MDAC (task 11)
tasks.outcome: success after a wrong turn (flights-only home search)

tasks.task: Nearest nursing room at KLIA T1 (task 7)
tasks.outcome: partial (honest 'not yet verified' in a guide after a dead end in Facilities)

tasks.task: Baby milk and food through security (task 12)
How and when to request assistance (task 10)

tasks.outcome: partial (planned closure at 0 interactions; current status not stated)

tasks.task: Switch to Malay and 125% text, then arrive-by time for MH 570 (task 3)
tasks.outcome: success ('Tiba di lapangan terbang sebelum 15:55'), 8 scrolls deep on phone

tasks.task: Reach a verified phone number and call it (task 14)
What the Butterfly Effect offers and how to register (task 10)
Self-transfer plan: arrive T1, leave T2, separate tickets, 3 h (task 9)
tasks.outcome: success (steps and verdict 'Tight'; verdict at 4,279 px on phone)

tasks.task: Train or shuttle between terminals: fare and frequency (part of task 9)
tasks.outcome: success (RM2 train, free shuttle, 10 or 15 min conflict stated)

tasks.task: Follow FY 3499 and find it again from home (task 1, repeat use)
tasks.outcome: success (saved flight on home at y=462 px)

tasks.task: Switch to Subang and find its parking daily cap (task 5)
tasks.outcome: failed (Parking tile silently opens the overview, which has no parking)

tasks.task: Meet MH 2088: when, where to wait, where to pick up (task 6)
tasks.outcome: success with a gap (exit estimate 19:40 and arrival hall Level 3; no pick-up point)

tasks.task: Price of 2-3 hours at the Terminal 1 car park (task 5)
tasks.outcome: failed honestly ('No estimate: rates not verified')

findings.title: No anti-touting or official-taxi guidance at the KLIA-to-city transport decision
findings.evidence: P2-T1, phone and desktop: the page text contains no 'tout', 'scam', 'unofficial' or 'offering a ride' (string search of rendered main). With the default destination KL Sentral the official coupon taxi is listed only under 'Not listed for KL Sentral'; its counter locations and indicative fares appear only after changing the destination to the city zone. The guidance exists elsewhere: the arrival flight page says 'ignore anyone who approaches you offering a ride', and Help has 'Someone offered me a ride in the arrival hall. Should I take it?'.
findings.expected: Strategy 4.2 'Ground transport' and BR-11: at the transport decision, state that official taxis are booked at counters and e-hailing at signed pick-up points, with the scam guidance beside them.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a short callout at the top of the transport page on arrival-side views (and beside taxi and e-hailing cards): 'Book taxis only at the coupon counters; ignore anyone offering a ride', linking to the Help scam answer. Show the coupon taxi with its counters for every city destination rather than under 'Not listed'.

findings.title: Home tiles and navigation silently fall back to the airport overview when a section is missing
findings.evidence: P8-T2: after Choose airport, then Subang, the home tiles 'Getting to the airport', 'Parking: Car parks and how to pay', 'Terminal maps', 'Lounges' and 'Food and shops' all link to /en/szb; the overview never mentions parking. Section availability by curl: szb, kch and lgk return 404 for parking, transport, lounges, shop-dine and facilities. sectionHref() replaces any unavailable section with 'overview' without telling the user.
findings.expected: A tile labelled Parking either reaches parking information or says plainly that parking at this airport is not published yet, with the official contact (principle 4, 'Say what we do not know').
findings.suggested_fix: When hasSection() is false, keep the tile but mark it 'Not published for Subang' and link to a small honest state (official page, phone) instead of the overview; or hide unavailable tiles with a one-line note. Apply the same to PRIMARY_NAV.

findings.title: The home's main search is flights-only and dead-ends on topic queries
findings.evidence: P2-T2: typing 'arrival card' into the prominent home field ('Flight, city or airline') shows '0 flights found. No demonstration flights match "arrival card". Try a flight number, a city, an airline, or a route such as KUL-PEN.' with no link to site search. Pressing Enter stays on /en. The site search (bottom-bar Search, same magnifier icon) finds the MDAC answer in two interactions.
findings.expected: BR-19 'One site search for flights, facilities, services and pages'. At minimum the empty state should hand the query to site search.
findings.suggested_fix: In the flight search empty state, add 'Search the whole site for "arrival card"' (linking to /search?q=) and show the top non-flight suggestions from the same index; consider accepting topics in the home field and showing flights first.

findings.title: Departed flight's journey timeline still marks 'Board from 11:15, be at the gate' as Now
findings.evidence: At 18:10 MYT the status panel says 'Departed, actual 12:00'. The timeline lists earlier steps as 'Done:' and the last one as 'Now: 11:15 Board from 11:15 ... Be at the gate before then with your boarding pass'. finalise() marks the last step whose time has passed as current regardless of flight status.
findings.expected: Clarity of status: when the flight has departed (or landed, or is cancelled), the timeline says so and no step tells the passenger to go somewhere.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the flight status into finalise(); for departed, landed or cancelled flights mark all departure steps done and show a terminal state ('This flight has departed' or 'Cancelled: contact the airline'). Add a unit test for a departed flight.

findings.title: Map gives an illustrative prayer-room pin a level and area that the directory says are unpublished
findings.evidence: Facilities (T1) card 'Prayer rooms (surau)': 'Locations and levels are not yet verified ... Not published: Location, Level, Area, Opening hours and Accessibility', tagged 'Official instruction', with a 'Show on map' link. That link opens a detail panel 'PRAYER ROOM (SURAU) · LEVEL 5 ... Level: Level 5: departures. Area: Public area (landside)'. The point is defined with provenance 'demo' and placed on L5 landside.
findings.expected: Trust and provenance: an unverified location is never presented as structured fact. Either the map shows no pin, or the panel states 'Position illustrative: level and area not published'.
findings.suggested_fix: For demo-provenance points linked to a facility with unpublished location, suppress Level and Area fields (show 'Not published'), or do not render 'Show on map' for such facilities. Add a content test that a map point cannot assert fields the referenced facility lacks.

findings.title: About 440 px of airport chrome pushes every task answer below the phone's first screen
findings.url: /en/kul/flights/mh570-20261118-d (also transport, parking, facilities, map, transit, board)
findings.evidence: Measured at 390x844: main h1 top is 440 px on the flight, transport, parking, facilities, map and transit pages and 414 px on the board; the fixed bottom bar takes 90 px, leaving about 300 px. Positions on the phone: gate on the flight page 1,306 px; KLIA Ekspres fare about 1,312-1,500 px (2 scrolls); first board row 1,185 px; parking quick-stay buttons 2,029 px. On the flight page the full demo banner sits between the title and the status.
findings.expected: Strategy principle 1: 'the answer or its control is visible without scrolling at 360 by 800 and 1280 by 720'.
findings.suggested_fix: Collapse the airport header on task pages (one line: airport code, terminal chip, airport time), make the section tabs scroll away or move into a compact 'Sections' menu, and put a one-line answer summary directly under each h1 (flight: status, terminal, gate, arrive-by; transport: cheapest official option and fare; parking: estimate). Add the 360x800 first-screen e2e check the strategy describes.

findings.title: Self-transfer verdict is 4,279 px down the phone page, after eleven steps
findings.evidence: Measured: planner form at 629 px, 'Your steps' at 1,644 px, verdict 'Tight. Your time sits inside our estimate. A long queue or a late arrival could make you miss the flight.' at 4,279 px on the phone (2,652 px on desktop). P7-T1 took 6 interactions and 6 phone scrolls to read the steps; the verdict needs more.
findings.expected: Strategy P7 success: 'ordered steps, an estimated buffer verdict and what to do if tight'; the verdict is the answer to 'is my time enough?' and belongs next to the inputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Render a verdict summary card directly below the form (verdict word, one sentence, 'If it is tight' link), keep the detailed estimate and steps below, and announce verdict changes politely.

findings.title: No Assistance entry in the desktop header
findings.evidence: Desktop header links: Flights, Plan your journey, At the airport, Shop & dine, Transport & parking, Help, plus icon buttons. 'Assistance and accessibility' is only in the footer on desktop and under Menu, then More on the phone. P4-T1 desktop went Help, then 'How do I ask for a wheelchair?'; P6-T1 desktop had to use site search ('autism').
findings.expected: Strategy 4.2 Accessibility step 1: 'Assistance is in the header and Help on every page'; BR-18 'An assistance hub at the top level'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Assistance' to PRIMARY_NAV (or as a labelled utility link next to Display settings) linking to /accessibility; on the phone, surface it in the first group of the menu.

findings.title: Greeter view leads with long-stay parking and gives no pick-up point
findings.evidence: P9-T1: the Meeting steps start with 'Decide where to park or wait', followed by notes 'Parking for a longer trip' (Long Term Car Park shuttle) and 'Parking for more than a day? Avoid Preferred Parking' (RM2,084 bill). The exit estimate ('Expect them from about 19:40', Estimated) and 'Wait in the arrival hall' (Level 3) are good. There is no pick-up point, e-hailing pick-up area or entry fee; only 'Do not wait at the kerb'.
findings.expected: Strategy 4.2 Meeting step 3: short-stay parking from the calculator and pick-up points and the e-hailing entry fee with their dates; BR-23.
findings.suggested_fix: For the meeting kind, attach short-stay notes (Terminal 1 car park, kerb rules, e-hailing pick-up area and RM2 entry fee with date) and drop long-stay warnings; link 'See parking' with a 3-hour preset.

findings.title: Arrive-by time is 3,448 px down the phone flight page (8 scrolls at 125% text)
findings.evidence: P5-T1: after setting Malay and 125%, 'Tiba di lapangan terbang sebelum 15:55' needed 8 scrolls on the phone (5 on desktop). In English at 100% the step is at 3,448 px on the phone (2,324 px on desktop). The status panel shows scheduled and estimated time, terminal and gate but not the arrive-by time.
findings.expected: Strategy task 3 (when to leave) is high criticality; principle 1 says the answer is in the first screen.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Be at the airport by hh:mm (estimate)' to the status panel and to the inline search card, linking to the timeline step.

findings.title: No current status for the Aerotrain or the inter-terminal link
findings.evidence: P4-T2: the home shows 'Planned: no Aerotrain between midnight and 5am, 28 November to 1 December' (0 interactions); Details opens the notice. Nothing on the home, notices, transit or map says whether the Aerotrain, train or shuttle is running now; the transit page states the 10 versus 15 minute shuttle conflict but no live line.
findings.expected: BR-08 operational status layer; strategy task 8 target '0 when active; 1 otherwise'. In the prototype, without a feed, say so: 'No disruption reported in our sources as of hh:mm; check the signs'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a status line component for Aerotrain, inter-terminal train and shuttle with a timestamp and source, fed by the notices content until a live feed exists; show it on the home notice strip, transit and the C-gate flight steps.

findings.title: Nursing rooms are absent from Facilities with no 'not published' placeholder
findings.evidence: P3-T1: 17 facilities at T1, none about nursing or baby care, although 'nursing-room' is a defined category. The only answer is in the Families guide ('This prototype has not yet verified nursing rooms or play areas. Ask at an information counter'), reached by site search after a dead end. The map does list 'Not on this map yet: Accessible toilets, Nursing rooms'.
findings.expected: Principle 4 and strategy P3 success: 'the nearest nursing room ... or Not published with the official contact', in the place parents look.
findings.suggested_fix: Render placeholder cards in Facilities for expected but unverified categories (nursing room, accessible toilet) with 'Not published' and the information-counter route, mirroring the map's 'Not on this map yet' list.

findings.title: No airline-to-terminal answer in search or the concierge
findings.evidence: 'AirAsia' returns 8 demo flight rows from mixed airports (LGK, PEN, KUL, BKI, SZB), with no airline entity. 'AirAsia terminal' returns 58 results led by transport items. POST /api/concierge 'Which terminal does AirAsia use at KLIA?' answers 'I could not match that to one topic'. The only statement is an Estimated note on flight pages ('Terminal 2 ... used mainly by AirAsia and AirAsia X').
findings.expected: Strategy task 2 (high criticality, target 1 interaction) and BR-19 entity results.
findings.suggested_fix: Add airline entities to the search index (airline, terminal at KLIA, provenance and date, 'confirm on your booking') and a concierge intent for 'which terminal'; where unverified, say so.

findings.title: Two adjacent toggles with overlapping words (Departures/Arrivals and Departing/Arriving)
findings.evidence: Home first screen (phone and desktop screenshots): 'Departures | Arrivals' (search scope) and, below, 'Departing | Arriving | Transiting | Meeting someone' (journey mode). Choosing Arriving or Meeting also switches the search to arrivals, so the two controls overlap in meaning.
findings.expected: Consistency and minimalism: one concept, one control.
findings.suggested_fix: Let the journey mode drive the search scope and hide the separate toggle (keep a small 'Search departures instead' link), or rename the scope toggle 'Flights leaving / Flights landing'.

findings.title: One destination, many labels
findings.evidence: Counted in en.ts and features/*.ts: transport has 'Getting to the airport', 'Getting to and from', 'Transport & parking', 'Leaving the airport', 'Getting to {airport}', 'Getting to the terminal'; shop and dine has 'Shop & dine', 'Shop and dine', 'Food and shops'; lounges has 4 variants; facilities has 'At the airport', 'Facilities and services', 'Facilities'. In P2-T1 the default tile 'Getting to the airport' was the decision point for an arriving visitor.
findings.expected: Consistent nouns across the tile, section tab and page title; mode-specific verbs are fine.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix one noun per section (for example 'Transport', 'Parking', 'Shops and food', 'Lounges', 'Facilities', 'Terminal map'), use verbs only as tile subtitles, and add a lint check for section labels in both dictionaries.

findings.title: Grammar and wording errors in demo, concierge and parking copy
findings.evidence: 'These are demonstration flights. Do not use it to plan travel.' (flight-search-box.tsx:285 joins flights.search.demoNote and demo.doNotPlan). Concierge: 'our sources list train between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 and free shuttle bus between the terminals.' (concierge.ts:153 template). Parking calculator: 'Arrival date', 'Departure date' and 'Your departure must be after your arrival.' for car-park entry and exit. 'Calm Room' beside 'Calm Room (Terminal 2)'.
findings.expected: Plain, grammatical, unambiguous copy.
findings.suggested_fix: 'These flights are simulated. Do not use them to plan travel.'; rewrite the transfer template as a sentence with articles; use 'Entry' and 'Exit' in the calculator; name 'Calm Room (Terminal 1)'.

findings.title: Provenance and 'not verified' notes are dense and inconsistently named
findings.evidence: Rendered-text counts on the phone: Facilities 17.5 screens with about 21 provenance tags, 21 'N sources' disclosures and 27 'Not published/not verified' mentions; Transport 13.2 screens with 22 not-verified mentions; Map about 24 tags and 18 demo labels. Tag names vary: 'Official instruction' and 'Official', 'Estimated guidance' and 'Estimated'. 'Official instruction' is applied to facts (a lounge description) and sits beside 'Not published' on the prayer-room card. The 'What this prototype has not verified at KLIA' list repeats on flight, transport and transit pages.
findings.expected: Provenance that is noticed and understood; one name per tag; no repeated boilerplate.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one short tag set (Official, Estimated, Suggestion, Demo, Not published); keep 'instruction' for rules only; group unpublished fields into one line per card; show the 'not verified' list once per airport (overview or About this prototype) and link to it. Test comprehension in the study (section 7.5).

findings.title: Full demo banner on every flight surface costs about 200 px of the phone's first screen
findings.evidence: Phone screenshot: the yellow striped 'DEMONSTRATION DATA' banner (about 200 px) sits between the h1 and 'Flight status', which starts under the bottom bar. The page also carries 'Demo' on 6 elements and the header 'Concept prototype, not official'.
findings.expected: Principle 2 (never present simulated data as live) without displacing the answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the per-element Demo tags; reduce the banner to one compact line under the status panel, or show the full banner once per session with a persistent compact line afterwards.

findings.title: No price for short stays at the Terminal 1 car park; booking hand-off carries no dates
findings.evidence: P9-T2: Terminal 1 Car Park, 3 hours: 'No estimate: rates not verified ... an undated Malaysia Airports page gives RM4 an hour for the first three hours and klia.info gives a daily maximum of RM52'. P1-T2: Long Term Car Park 3 days gives 'At most RM 96' (upper bound from the daily maximum). 'Book parking online' opens the official page in a new tab without dates. Content gap acknowledged in the integration hand-off (section 6, item 3).
findings.expected: BR-10 price-first parking; strategy task 5 target 3 interactions to a price.
findings.suggested_fix: Obtain the official rate card (MAHB) so the calculator can run; until then show the conflicting figures as a range with dates ('RM4 to RM? an hour, sources differ') and pass dates in the hand-off once a partner agreement allows.

findings.title: The 39-airport chooser interrupts five tasks; KLIA is not pinned
findings.evidence: With no airport chosen, every home tile and primary nav item goes to the chooser (P1-T2, P2-T1, P3-T1, P7-T1, P9-T2). On the phone the KLIA links sit at about 1,643 to 1,767 px, below the search, state and type filters (1 to 2 scrolls). The home's own airport dialog lists KLIA Terminal 1 and 2 first.
findings.expected: Efficiency: the most likely choice first; recognition over recall.
findings.suggested_fix: On the chooser page, pin KLIA Terminal 1, KLIA Terminal 2 and the last-used airport as large buttons above the filters, matching the home dialog.

findings.title: Consent screen interrupts a suggested concierge question; concierge hard to reach on phone
findings.evidence: P7-T2: tapping 'How do I get from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2?' opens 'Before you ask' (what is sent, what is kept, AI wording) with 'Agree and start | Not now'; the answer appears only after Agree. On the phone the suggestions sit about 6,600 px down the home (11 scrolls modelled); the bottom bar has no concierge entry (it is in Menu).
findings.expected: Stress-state usability: a tapped question is answered with minimal friction; the privacy notice stays visible.
findings.suggested_fix: Answer deterministic (non-AI) questions immediately with the notice shown inline above the answer; ask for consent only before AI wording or a saved flight is used. Offer the concierge from the Search sheet on phones.

findings.title: Phone numbers are 5,226 px down the phone Help centre
findings.evidence: P5-T2: Help centre opens with common questions, topic cards, 'Who handles what' and 'If it is not resolved'; the 'Contact Malaysia Airports' section with tel: links starts at 5,226 px. The 'Contact Malaysia Airports' topic card reaches /help/contact, where the numbers are at 459 px. Path: 4 interactions on the phone, 3 on desktop, against a target of 2.
findings.expected: Strategy P5 success: 'reaches a verified number in one tap'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a compact 'Call Malaysia Airports' row (group line, labelled) near the top of Help and in the phone menu.

findings.title: Airline check-in string untranslated on the Malay flight page
findings.evidence: String scan of 14 Malay pages: English hits 0 on 9 pages and at most 2 on the rest, mostly product names ('Meet and Assist', 'Relax & Refresh'). On the Malay flight page 'Self-service bag drop: counters F and G' is in English with no translation notice.
findings.expected: BR-16 parity, or a visible notice where content falls back.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the ms field for the airline check-in notes, or show the TranslationNotice on that card.

findings.title: Arriving mode does not add the entry checklist to the home
findings.evidence: With Arriving selected the home h2s are: Operational notice, Arrivals, Your journey step by step, One network 39 airports, Find something good, Ask in your own words. No 'Malaysia Digital Arrival Card' or entry text anywhere on the page (string search). The MDAC rule exists in the Arriving guide and on arrival flight pages.
findings.expected: Strategy 4.2 Arriving step 1: 'Arriving mode reorders the home: arrivals board, entry checklist, transport into the city'.
findings.suggested_fix: In Arriving mode, add an 'Before you land' card (MDAC within three days, free on the official portal, source and date; link to the Arriving guide).

findings.title: A missing airport section returns 'Page not found' under the title 'Parking at Subang'
findings.evidence: HTTP 404 with body 'Page not found' but document title 'Parking at Subang | Malaysia Airports'. generateMetadata builds the section title whenever the airport exists, before the page checks section availability. Reachable from bookmarks, shared links or search engines.
findings.expected: A not-found page announces itself as not found (title and h1 agree).
findings.suggested_fix: In generateMetadata, return the not-found title (and noindex) when hasSection() is false; apply to parking, transport, facilities, lounges and shop-dine.
